description: This file defines the class GoteoTemplate, which handles database migration SQL statements relating to email templates for project review notifications in multiple languages and formats (HTML and Markdown). It includes methods for generating SQL for migration up/down processes, with references to specific template IDs and language variations.

classes.name: GoteoTemplate
classes.description: A class that provides SQL migration scripts for email templates related to project review notifications in multiple languages and formats.

methods.name: preUp
methods.description: Placeholder for code to be executed before applying the 'up' migration.

methods.name: postUp
methods.description: Placeholder for code to be executed after applying the 'up' migration.

methods.name: preDown
methods.description: Placeholder for code to be executed before applying the 'down' migration.

methods.name: postDown
methods.description: Placeholder for code to be executed after applying the 'down' migration.

methods.name: getUpSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to execute when applying the 'up' migration (updating email templates).

methods.name: getDownSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to execute when applying the 'down' migration (restoring previous email templates).
